summary: Road end beside bushland and park; homes 13-16 m away on this side.
reasons: Beyond 20 m no formed road seen

best_section.where: At the road end by the corner, beside the bushland and park

drivers.seclusion: Bush and park on the line side; two houses 13 and 16 m away on the south side.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed corner reaches the start; a car is parked at about 10 m. Past 20 m the line runs through dense bush with no clear road.
drivers.traffic: Quiet end of a residential street; the motorway lies about 150 m north-west.
drivers.convention: A single car seen at the road end; no camping convention.
